capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Reading layout metadata, browsing the FileMaker Explorer, and running Find queries work in untrusted workspaces. Write operations (record edit/create/delete, batch updates, type generation, FM Web project init) and enterprise environment comparisons require a trusted workspace. Trust the workspace via VS Code's banner to enable them.
commands.filemakerDataApiTools.generateT: FileMaker: Generate Types for All Layouts
configuration.filemaker.advanced.powerUs: Surface diagnostic / plugin / circuit-breaker / job-runner / import-export commands in the Command Palette. Off by default to keep the FileMaker palette focused on commands new users actually need.
configuration.filemaker.batch.concurrenc: Maximum concurrent write operations for batch update execution.
configuration.filemaker.batch.dryRunDefa: Default dry-run mode for batch updates.
configuration.filemaker.batch.maxRecords: Safety cap for batch export record count.
configuration.filemaker.connect.backoffI: Initial delay (ms) before the first retry of a failed connect.
configuration.filemaker.connect.backoffM: Maximum delay (ms) the connect backoff will wait between retries.
Exponential multiplier applied to the connect backoff delay between retries.
configuration.filemaker.connect.maxRetri: Number of retries the FileMaker connect command performs on transient login failures (network errors, 5xx). 0 disables retry.
configuration.filemaker.connectionWizard: Whether the connection wizard requires a successful Test Connection before Save. 'off' = no requirement; 'warn' = save with confirmation when untested or edits since last test; 'block' = save disabled until a successful test on the current values.
configuration.filemaker.defaultApiBasePa: Default API base path used when a profile does not override it. Replaces the deprecated `filemakerDataApiTools.defaultApiBasePath`.
configuration.filemaker.defaultApiVersio: Default FileMaker Data API version segment used when a profile does not override it. Replaces the deprecated `filemakerDataApiTools.defaultApiVersionPath`.
Enable enterprise governance controls and role-based feature gating.
Enterprise role used for feature access control.
configuration.filemaker.features.batch.e: Enable batch export/update features (auto-disabled in untrusted workspaces).
configuration.filemaker.features.scriptR: Enable Script Runner UI and script execution features.
configuration.filemaker.fmWeb.bridge.rat: Burst capacity for the bridge token bucket — max requests permitted in a single instant. Default 60.
Sustained requests-per-second cap on the local FM bridge server. Throttled requests get HTTP 429 with Retry-After. Default 20.
configuration.filemaker.fmWeb.bridge.req: Hard cap on total bridge requests per session token. After exhaustion, restart the bridge to reset. Default 10000.
configuration.filemaker.history.maxEntri: Maximum number of request history entries stored per workspace.
configuration.filemaker.logging.level.de: Minimum logging level for FileMaker Data API Tools output.
configuration.filemaker.offline.mode.des: Use cached metadata only and disable write operations.
configuration.filemaker.offline.staleCac: Hours after which the schema metadata cache is considered stale. The status bar shows a warning and a one-time toast is emitted. Set to 0 to disable the stale-cache warning.
configuration.filemaker.performance.mode: High-scale mode optimizes batch/export workflows for large datasets.
configuration.filemaker.requestTimeoutMs: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for FileMaker Data API requests. Replaces the deprecated `filemakerDataApiTools.requestTimeoutMs`.
configuration.filemaker.savedQueries.sco: Scope used to store saved queries.
configuration.filemaker.schema.cacheTtlS: Schema metadata cache TTL in seconds.
configuration.filemaker.schema.diagnosti: Publish schema diff changes to the Problems panel when diffing against latest snapshot.
configuration.filemaker.schema.hashAlgor: Hash algorithm used for schema metadata fingerprinting.
configuration.filemaker.schema.metadataE: Enable layout metadata lookups for schema/field browsing.
configuration.filemaker.schema.snapshots: Maximum number of schema snapshots to retain per layout. Oldest snapshots are pruned automatically.
Storage backend for schema snapshots. In untrusted workspaces, workspaceState is used automatically.
configuration.filemaker.secrets.fallback: Behavior when VS Code SecretStorage is unavailable. 'vscode-only' (default) propagates the error. 'workspace-state' encrypts secrets to workspace state for headless / remote-agent setups. 'disabled' skips secret persistence entirely (development only).
configuration.filemaker.session.maxAgeMi: Treat the FileMaker Data API session token as expired after this many minutes from issuance. Default 14 (FM tokens nominally expire at 15).
configuration.filemaker.session.refreshL: Refresh the session token proactively when this many seconds remain before nominal expiry. Set to 0 to disable proactive refresh and rely on 401-retry only.
configuration.filemaker.snippets.include: Whether generated curl/fetch snippets include authorization headers by default.
configuration.filemaker.telemetry.enable: Enable anonymous usage telemetry to help improve the extension. No personal data or FileMaker credentials are collected.
configuration.filemaker.typegen.outputDi: Workspace output folder for generated TypeScript layout types.
configuration.filemakerDataApiTools.defa: Default API base path used when a profile does not override it.
Default FileMaker Data API version segment used when a profile does not override it.
configuration.filemakerDataApiTools.logL: Minimum log level written to the FileMaker Data API Tools output channel.
configuration.filemakerDataApiTools.requ: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for FileMaker Data API requests.
configuration.title: FileMaker Data API Tools
extension.description: Query, edit, and explore FileMaker data without leaving VS Code. Full CRUD for fmrest, visual query builder, schema diffing, batch import/export, and TypeScript type generation for Claris FileMaker Server and FileMaker Cloud.

Your passwords stay in the OS keychain. Learn more in the [User Guide](command:filemakerDataApiTools.openUserGuide).
walkthroughs.filemakerGettingStarted.des: Set up a connection profile and run your first query in three steps.
walkthroughs.filemakerGettingStarted.ste:
Tell the extension how to reach your FileMaker server. Passwords go to the OS keychain — they never touch your workspace files.
[Add Profile](command:filemakerDataApiTools.addConnectionProfile)

Open a session against the Data API. Transient failures retry with exponential backoff and the token refreshes proactively before expiry.
[Connect](command:filemakerDataApiTools.connect)

List layouts, pick one, and open the Query Builder. Field-name chips above the JSON editor save typing.
[Open Query Builder](command:filemakerDataApiTools.openQueryBuilder)
